headline: Deutsche Bank shares fall more than 6% after reports on payments to Epstein and business with Russia
summary: Deutsche Bank shares fell more than 6% after media reports renewed scrutiny of its past relationships with Russian oligarchs, Donald Trump and Jeffrey Epstein.
why: Deutsche Bank is one of Germany's largest lenders, and reputational and legal scrutiny of its client relationships can affect its share price and regulatory standing.
why_moved: Media reports revived scrutiny of the bank's past relationships with Russian oligarchs, Trump and Jeffrey Epstein, and the shares fell more than 6%.
original_headline: Acciones de Deutsche Bank caen más de 6% tras noticias sobre pagos a Epstein y negocios con Rusia
